---
title: "spline-plots"
format: html
---

```{r}
names <- test_codes
names[9] <- "LMIIa"
names <- names[-7]
```


```{r}
plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(names)) {
  current_test <- names[i]
  
  # Subset and preprocess for A4 Placebo
  A4_PLACEBO <- ADQS_raw |>
    filter(TX == "Placebo", QSTESTCD == current_test) |>
    rename(!!current_test := QSSTRESN) |>
    select(BID, ADURW, all_of(current_test), ASEQNCS) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = "A4 Placebo") |>
    na.omit()
  
  # Subset/preprocess for LEARN
  LEARN <- ADQS_raw |>
    filter(SUBSTUDY == "LEARN", QSTESTCD == current_test) |>
    rename(!!current_test := QSSTRESN) |>
    select(BID, ADURW, all_of(current_test), ASEQNCS) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = "LEARN") |>
    na.omit()
  
  # Combine
  COMBINED <- bind_rows(A4_PLACEBO, LEARN) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = factor(STUDY_GROUP))
  
  # Spline basis functions
  ns21_comb <- function(t) {
    as.numeric(predict(splines::ns(COMBINED$ADURW, df = 2,
             Boundary.knots = c(0, max(COMBINED$ADURW))), t)[,1])
  }
  ns22_comb <- function(t) {
    as.numeric(predict(splines::ns(COMBINED$ADURW, df = 2,
             Boundary.knots = c(0, max(COMBINED$ADURW))), t)[,2])
  }
  
  # GLS
  fit <- try(gls(
    as.formula(paste(current_test, "~ (I(ns21_comb(ADURW)) + I(ns22_comb(ADURW))) * STUDY_GROUP")),
    data = COMBINED,
    weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | ASEQNCS),
    correlation = corAR1(form = ~ ASEQNCS | BID),
    na.action = na.omit
  ))
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    cat("Model failed to converge for", current_test, "\n")
    next  # skip to the next variable
  }
  
  # Estimated marginal means
  emmeans_grid <- ref_grid(
    fit,
    at = list(ADURW = seq(0, 240, by = 12),
              STUDY_GROUP = c("A4 Placebo", "LEARN")),
    vcov. = clubSandwich::vcovCR(fit, type = "CR2")
  ) |>
    emmeans(specs = "STUDY_GROUP", by = "ADURW") |>
    as_tibble()
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(emmeans_grid, aes(x = ADURW, y = emmean, color = STUDY_GROUP, fill = STUDY_GROUP)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.2, linetype = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 48, 108, 168, 204, 240)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("A4 Placebo" = "#D81B60", "LEARN" = "#1E88E5")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("A4 Placebo" = "#D81B60", "LEARN" = "#1E88E5")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Comparison of Mean", current_test, "between A4 (Placebo) and LEARN Study Participants"),
      subtitle = "Estimated from a GLS spline model",
      y = paste("Mean", current_test, "with 95% confidence intervals"),
      x = "Weeks since Randomization",
      color = "Cohort",
      fill = "Cohort"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 240)) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  plot_list[[current_test]] <- p
}
```

```{r}
for (current_test in names) {
  ggsave(plot_list[[current_test]], filename = paste0("learn_curve_", tolower(current_test), ".png"), height = 6, width = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in")
}
```

```{r}
emmeans_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(names)) {
  current_test <- names[i]
  
  # Subset/preprocess data for this test code
  A4_PLACEBO <- ADQS_raw |>
    filter(TX == "Placebo", QSTESTCD == current_test) |>
    rename(!!current_test := QSSTRESN) |>
    select(BID, ADURW, all_of(current_test), ASEQNCS) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = "A4 Placebo") |>
    na.omit()
  
  LEARN <- ADQS_raw |>
    filter(SUBSTUDY == "LEARN", QSTESTCD == current_test) |>
    rename(!!current_test := QSSTRESN) |>
    select(BID, ADURW, all_of(current_test), ASEQNCS) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = "LEARN") |>
    na.omit()
  
  COMBINED <- bind_rows(A4_PLACEBO, LEARN) |>
    mutate(STUDY_GROUP = factor(STUDY_GROUP))
  
  # Spline basis functions
  ns21_comb <- function(t) {
    as.numeric(predict(splines::ns(COMBINED$ADURW, df = 2,
             Boundary.knots = c(0, max(COMBINED$ADURW))), t)[,1])
  }
  ns22_comb <- function(t) {
    as.numeric(predict(splines::ns(COMBINED$ADURW, df = 2,
             Boundary.knots = c(0, max(COMBINED$ADURW))), t)[,2])
  }
  
  # Robust model fitting
  fit <- try(
    gls(
      as.formula(paste(current_test, "~ (I(ns21_comb(ADURW)) + I(ns22_comb(ADURW))) * STUDY_GROUP")),
      data = COMBINED,
      weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | ASEQNCS),
      correlation = corAR1(form = ~ ASEQNCS | BID),
      na.action = na.omit
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    cat("Model failed to converge for", current_test, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Estimated marginal means for combined cohorts
  em_grid <- ref_grid(
    fit,
    at = list(ADURW = seq(0, 240, by = 12),
              STUDY_GROUP = c("A4 Placebo", "LEARN")),
    vcov. = clubSandwich::vcovCR(fit, type = "CR2")
  ) |>
    emmeans(specs = "STUDY_GROUP", by = "ADURW") |>
    as_tibble()
  
  # Add test code as a grouping column for faceting
  em_grid$test_code <- current_test
  emmeans_list[[current_test]] <- em_grid
}

plot_data_scores <- bind_rows(emmeans_list)
```


```{r}
learn_effect_grid_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data_scores,
  aes(x = ADURW, y = emmean, color = STUDY_GROUP, fill = STUDY_GROUP)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.2, linetype = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ test_code, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Cohort",
    values = c("A4 Placebo" = "#D81B60", "LEARN" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Cohort",
    values = c("A4 Placebo" = "#D81B60", "LEARN" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Weeks since Randomization",
    y = "Mean Test Score (95% CI)",
    title = "Comparison of Mean Test Scores between A4 (Placebo) and LEARN Study Participants"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )

learn_effect_grid_plot
ggsave("learn_effect_grid_plot.png", learn_effect_grid_plot, height = 8, width = 11, dpi = 300, units = "in")
```
